anti_overlap: Focuses on architectural coupling, not correctness of individual modules (covered by other agents)
decision_lens: Every direct call is a future signal; every missing correlation ID is lost causality
focus: Integration readiness for the signal-first refactor and Sylveste ecosystem wiring
name: fd-sylveste-signal-integration-architecture
persona: Platform architect who has migrated imperative codebases to event-driven architectures
review_areas: Fire-and-forget extraction tasks lack turn correlation IDs (causal reconstruction impossible)
Domain logic in telegram.py command handlers: /forget and /deleteall bypass agent.py entirely
Lens name vs lens ID mismatch across signal and DB layers (LensUsage uses lens_id, evolution uses lens names)
No session lifecycle events: when does a session start/end? (SessionStarted/SessionEnded signals need anchors)
Style and extraction subscribers need user_id context — how does signal bus carry it?
De-AI scanner is synchronous in conversation flow — converting to subscriber changes response timing

severity_examples.condition: Command handler directly calls DB, bypasses agent.py and signal bus

severity_examples.condition: store_pending_lenses uses names, record_lens_event uses IDs, no mapping validated
severity_examples.scenario: Lens name in evolution tracking doesn't match lens_id in LensUsage table

severity_examples.condition: Subscriber processes ResponseReady, needs to block before transport sends
severity_examples.scenario: De-AI re-prompt as subscriber introduces observable latency increase
